title: Add per-tool website pages with curated guides and generated reference
description:
Give each catalog tool a dedicated static page at /tools/<id>/, linked from its name in the compact homepage directory. Explain when to use the tool and what to expect, alongside the existing generated launch information.

Keep curated website content and screenshot assets keyed by canonical catalog tool ID, separate from the launcher catalog. Generate technical reference from tools.json so launch commands, aliases, prerequisites, declared data files, source/documentation links, and default/beta targets stay consistent with the launcher. Present default and beta targets together on one page per tool.

Curated content can include an overview, common use cases, captioned screenshots or terminal examples, a short getting-started walkthrough, and relevant pitfalls or limitations. Generate a useful basic page for every tool; initially enrich a couple of representative tools (suggested: Pool Classifier and Taskcluster task creator).

Show a concrete mockup before substantial UI changes, then prepare a local or staging preview for user review. Keep implementation uncommitted and do not publish production without explicit approval.

Technical reference is generated from the existing catalog without duplicating its values in curated content. Default and beta targets share one page. At least two representative pages include curated guidance and a captioned screenshot or terminal example. Pages follow existing site styling and work without JavaScript for core content. Relevant site checks and link/asset validation pass, and a local or staging preview is available for review.
